title: The engine side of the Tank Arena spec
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The engine now does everything the approved Tank Arena spec asks of it: a line-of-sight check that walls and pillars block, per-tank stats so loadouts like Glass Cannon vs Brawler play out for real, each tank's max HP in what policies see, and optional steadier aim for tanks that stand still. Default matches play bit for bit as before; replays move to format 4 and older ones still load.
next: Blitzwing builds Charger, Kiter and Sniper and the loadout mapping on top.
